---
title: "Data Science Workshops"
---

Materials for the software workshops of [Data Science Services](https://www.iq.harvard.edu/data-science-services) at the Institute for Quantitative Social Science, Harvard University: notes to read, materials to download and follow along with, and exercises with solutions. Self-paced now; live workshops for groups return in 2027.

Start with [Data Science Tools](general/tools.qmd) if you are choosing a language or an editor; each language then has its own section in the sidebar, starting with an installation page. The materials were last tested with the versions in the [installation pages](r/install.qmd) ({{< var tested >}}).

## Contributors

These workshops were written by the Data Science Services team at IQSS. Contributors over the years: Ista Zahn, Steve Worthington, and Jinjie Liu.

These workshops are a work in progress; please send feedback to help@iq.harvard.edu.
